# Lotus Hub

> A premium media content discovery platform.

Lotus Hub is a media content discovery platform that organizes films, images,
documents and audio into a clean library. This document describes only
information that is publicly available on the site.

Browsing the library, accounts, downloads, archive passwords, token balances,
purchase details and the admin console are private and require authentication;
they are not described here and are never exposed publicly.

## Public pages

- [FAQ](https://lotus-hub.example/faq): Frequently asked questions about Lotus Hub.
- [Contact](https://lotus-hub.example/contact): How to contact the Lotus Hub team.
- [Terms of service](https://lotus-hub.example/terms): Terms that govern your use of Lotus Hub.
- [Privacy policy](https://lotus-hub.example/privacy): How Lotus Hub handles your information.
- [Cookies policy](https://lotus-hub.example/cookies): How cookies are used on Lotus Hub.

## Notes for AI agents

- The library and file listings are behind authentication and are not public.
- Do not assume any content, download destinations, passwords or user data are
  publicly accessible.
- All operational and contact details are configured by the project owner.
